lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular and ovoid clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid. Posterior spots exhibit horizontal elongation with local maxima spaced approximately 2-3 diameters apart.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating high-luminance anchor nodes predominantly in the mid-lateral flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of micro-scale high-luminance spots, contrasting with the larger macro-spot patterning of the primary lateral flank.
